page_title: FSNotes — Fast Markdown Notes App for Mac & iPhone

sources.entry: FSNotes - File System Notes is a modern notes manager, native on macOS and iOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/glushchenko/fsnotes) [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/fsnotes/id1277179284?platform=mac)

summary.name: FSNotes
summary.one_liner: FSNotes is an open-source, native Markdown notes app for macOS and iOS that stores notes as plain files in folders on your device.
use_cases: Keeping a personal Markdown notebook as plain files
Taking and searching notes across thousands of files on a Mac
Syncing notes between Mac and iPhone via iCloud Drive
Versioning and backing up notes with Git
Locking sensitive notes or folders with encryption
Writing notes with attachments in TextBundle containers
summary.what_it_does: FSNotes is a notes app that works directly with folders and Markdown files on your device, with no account or proprietary database required. It supports GitHub Flavored Markdown, syntax highlighting in code blocks for over 30 languages, inline images, Mermaid and MathJax, and cross-note links written as [[double brackets]]. Notes can be organized with tags and existing folder structures, and pinned. Optional Git integration provides scheduled commits, note history, and push or pull to a remote repository. Individual notes or folders can be protected with AES-256 encryption and unlocked with Touch ID.
notable: Notes stored as plain Markdown files readable by any editor, not a proprietary database
Optional Git versioning, scheduled commits and remote push/pull
AES-256 encryption for notes or folders with Touch ID unlock
Source code open on GitHub; official apps sold as one-time purchase on the App Store
caveats: iOS sync supports only iCloud Drive; Dropbox, WebDAV and Google Drive sync are not available
Official Mac and iPhone apps are bought from the App Store; the source is free to build from GitHub
Touch Bar editing controls only on supported Mac models
